empty: Start the conversation first — an empty chat can't be opened in a separate window
emptyReturn: Start the conversation first — an empty chat can't be returned to the main window
busy: Wait for Claude to finish responding, then the chat can be opened in a separate window
busyReturn: Wait for Claude to finish responding, then the chat can be returned to the main window
tasksRunning: Background tasks are running in this chat — wait for them to finish or stop them
agentsRunning: Agents are running in this chat — wait for them to finish
closeMessage: Claude is still working in this chat — the current response and background tasks will be stopped.
noChat: The window was opened without a chat
probeError: Couldn't start Claude Code: {error}. Make sure you're signed in (`claude` → /login).
